Title: Imbued vs Illusions of the Kindred

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
I just want to be sure I've understood what's happening in the Spell
of Life thread.
For that reason, here comes what was a dumb question (because it was
not asked), and is actually a stupid question.

My prey controls a Inez "Nurse216" Villagrande. Suddenly, it happens
that one of my vampires enters combat. I play an Illusions of the
Kindred, and reveal Inez "Nurse216" Villagrande.

Inez "Nurse216" Villagrande is *not* a vampire, so it should contest
my prey's Inez (since nothing is specified about contesting Imbueds on
Illusions of the Kindred). My Inez "Nurse216" Villagrande and my
prey's Inez "Nurse216" Villagrande do contest, and if my prey yields,
I can keep my Inez "Nurse216" Villagrande as long as I want.

Second ex-dumb question : When my Inez "Nurse216" Villagrande enters
play due to my Illusions, does it win a Conviction? Does its special
ability apply ? (cf. Sonja Blue + contest)
When it comes back from the contest, can it gain 1 power, due to its
special ability ?

Messages.Author: Wookie813
Messages.Body:


Found on this NG [search: Illusions Imbued]. Note point number three.

The following effects are not imbued-compatible:

* Chain of Command (cannot put imbued into play)
* Clotho's Gift at [tem] (cannot target imbued in uncontrolled
region)
* Illusions of the Kindred (if the bottom card is an imbued, no
new
combat begins and the imbued is removed from play.)
* Might of the Camarilla (won't force a Methuselah to burn an
uncontrolled imbued).
* Recruitment (search as indicated: vampire).
